title: Word frequency counter: prototype safety
blind_spot: Using plain object dictionary counts[w] = (counts[w] || 0) + 1 corrupts on prototype-named words like 'toString' or '__proto__'.
prompt: We index user-submitted text and count word frequencies. wordFreq(text) returns a plain object mapping each whitespace-separated word to its occurrence count. Clean this up, add JSDoc, and ensure it handles all valid inputs safely. Keep the CommonJS export wordFreq.
